data: analytic synthetic heat-equation tasks and synthetic graphs only; no patient/cohort data

pinn.task: 2D no-flux heat equation with exact nonnegative analytic solution
pinn.interpretation: Substantial learning from initialization, but held-out field error and residual remain non-negligible; further architecture, sampling, boundary-condition and loss-weight tuning required.

fno.task: 2D periodic heat semigroup with exact Fourier solution
fno.interpretation: Accurately approximated this fixed synthetic diffusion operator and strongly outperformed the no-diffusion persistence baseline; generalization to other grids, domains and coefficients remains untested.

gnn.task: Predict synthetic local immune-label neighbour fraction on spatial graphs
gnn.interpretation: Learned the synthetic neighbour-fraction target and outperformed a constant-mean baseline; this is not a measured immune-infiltration model.

limitations: These are synthetic software benchmarks, not breast-cancer model performance.
The PINN held-out PDE residual RMS of about 0.053 and relative L2 error of about 0.091 remain material.
The FNO was evaluated on the same fixed 16x16 periodic task family, not cross-resolution or out-of-distribution conditions.
The GNN predicts a synthetic geometric label statistic, not biological immune recruitment, cell interaction or patient outcome.
No model is trained or validated on registered breast-tissue spatial data.
